summary: Whether you show it or not, a need to be seen and to matter and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking. Owned, you shine and lead without trying and you reach, grow, and lift the room.
body: Whether you show it or not, a need to be seen and to matter and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something grind against each other inside you. gift: At your best: you shine and lead without trying, and you reach, grow, and lift the room.
shadow: The trap: you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking — or you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver.
integration: Let identity and growth and belief cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Confidence and opportunity, with overextension as the standing risk.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you shine and you reach, grow, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: You make it all about you
Let the reflex make the decision
